career.townstead.beverage_artisan.descri: A craftsperson of drinks, from everyday refreshments to specialist vintages.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.barista: Call a deliberate tea pause: nearby friends become harder to rattle, but nobody hurries through the cup. Costs 20 Stamina.
Learn when a living batch needs intervention—and when the finest tool in the cellar is time. Production rescue choices arrive in the protocol pass.
skill.townstead.beverage_artisan.bartend: Spend 30 Stamina to clear nausea from nearby guests. It steadies the room; it does not erase townstead_state:drunk or excuse what happened there.
career.townstead.cook.description: Turn everyday ingredients into nourishing meals and a lifetime at the stove into culinary mastery.
skill.townstead.cook.seasoned_hands.desc: Routine kitchen work has taught you how to waste less and recover faster. Gain 1 additional Cook XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.cook.steady_simmer.descr: Patience keeps the pot from boiling over and the cook from burning out. Gain 1 additional Cook XP for each Cook rank you hold.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.pizza_cra: Learn the foundations of dough, sauce, and heat that define a Pizzaiolo. Feed nearby allies to restore a little hunger when the kitchen turns dangerous.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.starter_c: A living starter rewards anyone willing to tend it instead of rushing it. Gain 1 additional Cook XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.kitchen_r: Dough, peel, and oven settle into a practiced rhythm. Gain 1 additional Cook XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.pizza_spi: Turn a practiced flourish into breathing room when the kitchen gets crowded. Strike and toss nearby foes into the air.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.stone_ove: Read the oven by its heat, stone, and breath instead of by the clock. Gain 2 additional Cook XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.peel_vaul: A pizza peel is a lever when the floor gets too hot to trust. Vault forward and upward to escape danger.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.stone_hea: Hold a hard, even heat through a long service. Gain fire resistance and ignite hostile creatures around you.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.blistered: The best crust carries the small scars of fierce heat and careful timing. Gain 2 additional Cook XP for each Cook rank you hold.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.peel_swee: Clear the floor with the same broad motion that turns a pie. Sweep nearby foes with the peel.
skill.townstead.cook.pizzaiolo.stone_wis: Every oven has a temperament; you have learned how to listen. Gain 3 additional Cook XP for each Cook rank you hold.
career.townstead.scribe.description: The village's pen—keeping the Archives, printing the bulletin, and helping neighbors find their calling.
skill.townstead.scribe.long_ledger.descr: Good records reveal the shape of years, not merely the business of a day. Gain 1 additional Scribe XP for each Scribe rank you hold.
skill.townstead.scribe.steady_hand.descr: A clear hand keeps every name, tally, and promise fit to be read again. Gain 1 additional Scribe XP whenever work is completed.
career.townstead.witch.description: A village herbalist and potion compounder who keeps exact remedies, volatile mixtures, and their consequences in careful custody.
career.townstead.baker.description: A cook devoted to the oven, from daily bread to fine pastry.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.clean_ja: A spotless jar protects careful work long after the kettle leaves the fire. Gain 1 additional Baker XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.setting_: Know the instant fruit, sugar, and heat become a preserve worth keeping. Gain 1 additional Baker XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.baker.jam_maker.slow_boi: Give fruit time to deepen without letting sweetness scorch. Gain 2 additional Baker XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.fine_c: Judge a bake by the tender pattern hidden beneath its crust. Gain 1 additional Baker XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.piping: A steady hand turns filling and icing into clean, confident flourishes. Gain 1 additional Baker XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.baker.pastry_chef.sugar_: Shape sweetness at the narrow edge between pliable and brittle. Gain 2 additional Baker XP whenever work is completed.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.appetizer_menu: A good appetizer opens the appetite and leaves everyone wanting more. Activate this skill to grant Strength to you and nearby allies for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.chef_de_cuisin: A busy kitchen does not overwhelm you. At 75 Flow or more in a kitchen, recover half a heart and 4 stamina every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.chefs_knife.de: A practiced hand makes quick work of anything on the chopping block. Equip a kitchen knife, then activate this skill to deal 6 damage to foes in front of you.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.dessert_menu.d: A sweet finish wraps the meal perfectly. Activate this skill to grant Speed and Haste to you and nearby allies for 11 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.dinner_rush.de: When every order arrives at once, there is no time for hesitation. Equip a kitchen weapon, then activate this skill to gain Strength II, Speed II, and Haste II for 8 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.flambe.descrip: Control the flame, and the spectacle takes care of itself. Activate this skill to deal 4 damage and set foes in front of you on fire for 5 seconds.
A perfect ballroom dance of culinary mastery. Activate this skill to grant Strength, Resistance, and Speed for 12 seconds, and Regeneration for 6 seconds, to you and nearby allies.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.kitchen_flow.d: Once you hit that flow state, it all becomes a well-executed dance. Near a lit heat source in a kitchen, gain 3 additional Flow every second.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.kitchen_pace.d: In the heat and stress of the kitchen, you thrive. Near a lit heat source in a kitchen, recover half a heart every 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.main_course.de: A substantial meal just anchors the whole thing. Activate this skill to grant Resistance and Absorption to you and nearby allies for 12 seconds.
When everything has its place, you are already ahead of the next order. While in a kitchen with storage nearby, recover 3 stamina every 2 seconds.
One clean cut in the right place is worth a dozen hurried blows. Equip a kitchen knife, then activate this skill to deal 9 damage and apply Weakness for 5 seconds to foes in a narrow arc.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.running_the_pa: You keep an eye on every station and know when each plate is ready to leave. While in a kitchen with another Cook nearby, gain 4 Flow every 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.saute_toss.des: A sharp turn of the wrist keeps everything moving. Equip a skillet, then activate this skill to deal 5 damage and launch foes in a wide arc.
skill.townstead.cook.chef.soup_course.de: A warm first course settles the nerves and puts strength back into hungry diners. Activate this skill to grant Regeneration to you and nearby allies for 8 seconds.
townstead_voice.mca.crabby.dialogue.chat: How am I supposed to fish with nothing, exactly?
Someone's taken my rod, haven't they. Hand one over.
Barrel's full. Should've thought of that, shouldn't we.
Fish everywhere, nowhere to put them. Planning, it's called planning.
Another chest. Today, preferably. I've had enough.
A fisherman with no water. What are we, a comedy?
You expect me to fish in the dirt? Find me a pond already.
Path's blocked. Who leaves things in the way like this?
I can't reach the water because someone couldn't be bothered to clean up.
Move whatever it is out of my way. Honestly.
townstead_voice.mca.flirty.dialogue.chat: Oh sweetheart, got a rod I could borrow? I promise I'll make it worth your while.
A girl needs her tackle, darling. Help a pretty thing out?
Come closer, love. I'd fish if I had a rod — know anyone who could lend me one?
My barrel's stuffed, darling, and not in the fun way.
Sweetie, I need somewhere to put my catch. Got room for me?
Cozy up a chest for me, love, my barrel's full to the brim.
Honey, all this talk of getting wet and not a drop of water in sight.
Sugar, I need water like you need sweet company. Help me out?
Find me a nice pond, handsome, and I'll do the rest.
Sugar, something's in my way and you know how I hate being stood up.
Darling, the path to my spot's a mess. Clear it for me?
Come sweep me a path, handsome, and I'll sweep you off your feet.
townstead_voice.mca.gloomy.dialogue.chat: No rod. Of course. Why would there be.
Empty hands, empty pack. Fitting, really.
A rod would help. Not that anyone's listening.
No room for the catch. No room for me, either, it seems.
The barrel rejects me. Even wood turns its back.
Everything's full except my heart. Another chest would help.
No water anywhere. Just like the warmth of friendship.
The pond's gone dry, or never was. Hard to say which is worse.
I need water. But I'll probably just stand here.
The path is blocked. Maybe it's a sign.
I can't reach the water. I can't reach much of anything, really.
Something's in the way. Feels fitting.
townstead_voice.mca.greedy.dialogue.chat: No rod, no fish, no profit. Fix it.
A rod is a tool. Tools make coin. Bring me one.
You want fish? Rods don't grow on trees. Well, technically...
Barrel's full. That's a good problem. Give me another.
Storage overflowing. More chests means more inventory means more profit.
Expand the operation. I need another container, now.
No water means no fish means no revenue. Unacceptable.
Dig me a pond, close by. Time is emeralds.
I need water. Preferably before my competitors get any.
Blocked path. That's lost revenue right there.
Can't reach the water, can't move product. Unacceptable.
Clear the way. Every minute I'm here costs us both.
townstead_voice.mca.odd.dialogue.chat.fi: The rod has gone. Perhaps it swam away.
No rod. The fish are relieved, I suspect.
A rod, a rod, my kingdom for a rod. Or half a rod. I'm flexible.
The barrel refuses further fish. It is a barrel with standards.
Too many fish, not enough box. A tale as old as time.
Another container, please. The fish have opinions about crowding.
The water has gone elsewhere. Perhaps a party.
Where there is no water, there are no fish. A profound insight.
I dreamed of a pond. Woke up. Still no pond. Please find one.
An invisible wall. Or a real one. Either way, unfortunate.
The path is a riddle today, and I do not have the answer.
Something blocks the way. Perhaps it is me. Perhaps it is geometry.
townstead_voice.mca.playful.dialogue.cha: Hey hey, no rod! Wanna go find me one? I'll do a little jig.
Psst — I'm rod-less over here! Rescue me?
No rod, no fish, no fun. Help a pal out!
Barrel's burstin'! Gonna start stuffing fish in my pockets.
I need another chest or these fish are going rogue!
Room for one more? Or ten more? Please?
Oh no, dry land as far as I can see! Pond, please?
Fish can't fly, last I checked. Got any water around?
Gimme a puddle, a pond, a bathtub — anything wet!
Road closed ahead! Send a hero to clear the way!
Something's blockin' the path. Tag, you're it!
Can't get to the water — obstacle course got me good.
townstead_voice.mca.relaxed.dialogue.cha: No rod on me. No worries, whenever you've got one.
Could use a rod. Take your time, I'll be here.
A rod would be nice. Plenty of time, friend.
Barrel's full. A spare chest anywhere around? No pressure.
My catch needs a home. I'll hold onto it 'til you sort one.
Whenever you get a moment, we could use another container.
No water to cast in. I'll wait 'til one turns up.
Point me at a pond, I'll take it from there. No rush.
Any water nearby? I'll just enjoy the quiet until you find one.
Path's a bit tricky today. Sort it when you can.
Can't quite reach the water. Nothing urgent, just a heads up.
Something's in the way. I'll wait it out.
combo_skill.townstead.charcutier.descrip: The butcher's block and the kitchen meet in cured meat. Earn 1 additional XP in both crafts whenever work is completed.
